summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.98/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.98 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 5, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 11. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 5¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.24 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.71) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.31).
